sources_considered.why: Primary financial filing available by the evaluation date. Its consolidated reporting does not provide the required separate profitability results.
Primary account of coding-product quality failures and their resolution. Relevant to the reliability concern, but not a representative target-quarter task evaluation.
The search result concerns projected aggregate gross margins, not realized target-quarter net profitability for each customer channel.
Secondary commentary combines later-period figures and margin estimates. The primary filing was preferred.

evidence_items.publisher: Anthropic, PBC; U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
evidence_items.explanation: The filing reports consolidated financial performance rather than separate subscription and enterprise segment profitability. It therefore does not settle the stronger channel-level reading.

Anthropic acknowledges three changes that impaired coding-product quality and reports fixing them. This documents specific failures, but also limits any inference that those defects remained present or established a general failure rate.

unresolved_gaps: No matched Q1 2026 subscription and enterprise profitability figures were obtained.
The claimed loss measure and treatment of shared costs are unspecified.
No representative target-period task evaluation establishes the broad frequency and oversight assertions.
The wording does not clearly distinguish company-wide unprofitability from losses on each type of customer.
